"CREATE A COMPLETE PLAYABLE MOBILE GAME.

GAME TITLE: PAPER WORLD
VERSION: 2.0

1. GAME CONCEPT
Create a polished 2D territory capture arcade game inspired by Paper.io 2. The player controls a colored square character and captures territory by drawing trails outside their existing territory and returning safely.

The game must be fully playable with functional mechanics, intelligent AI opponents, progression, menus and mobile controls.

2. GRAPHICS AND CAMERA
- Pure 2D graphics.
- Top-down orthographic camera.
- Flat colorful geometric visual style.
- Smooth animations.
- Clean grid-based arena.
- No 3D models or 3D camera.
- Camera follows the player smoothly.
- Keep the player visible near the center of the screen.
- Scale the arena properly for different mobile screen sizes.

3. CORE GAMEPLAY
- The player begins with a small colored territory.
- Move inside owned territory safely.
- Moving outside owned territory creates a visible colored trail.
- Return to owned territory to close the trail.
- Fill the enclosed area with the player's color.
- Calculate captured territory accurately.
- If an opponent touches the player's exposed trail, eliminate the player.
- If the player touches an AI opponent's exposed trail, eliminate that AI.
- A player cannot be eliminated by touching their own trail.
- Territory capture must update the map immediately.
- Show live territory percentage.
- Add smooth trail drawing and territory filling animations.

4. MAP AND ARENA
- Large square grid-based arena.
- Multiple colored territories.
- Clear arena boundaries.
- Distinct player colors.
- Mini-map showing all territories.
- Randomly generated arena layouts.
- Keep the map balanced and fair.
- Ensure all characters stay inside the arena.

5. AI OPPONENTS
Create 8 intelligent AI bots.
Each bot has:
- Unique name.
- Unique color.
- Individual territory.
- Different movement patterns.
- Territory expansion behavior.
- Defensive behavior.
- Offensive behavior.
- Trail awareness.

AI BEHAVIORS:
- Wander around owned territory.
- Occasionally venture outside to capture new areas.
- Return safely to their territory.
- Avoid dangerous situations.
- Recognize exposed trails.
- Attack nearby exposed trails when safe.
- Avoid unnecessary risky movements.
- Compete with other AI bots.
- React to changing territory sizes.

AI DIFFICULTY:
Easy, Normal, Hard and Expert.

6. MAIN MENU
Create a beautiful main menu with:
- PAPER WORLD logo.
- Animated colorful background.
- PLAY button.
- GAME MODES button.
- SKINS button.
- SHOP button.
- LEADERBOARD button.
- DAILY REWARDS button.
- SETTINGS button.
- Player profile.
- Player level.
- Coin balance.
- Best territory percentage.

All buttons must work.

7. GAME MODES
CLASSIC MODE:
Standard territory capture with AI bots.

TIME ATTACK:
Capture as much territory as possible before the countdown ends.

SURVIVAL:
Survive against increasingly challenging AI bots.

PRACTICE:
Practice territory capture with fewer AI opponents.

8. IN-GAME MOBILE UI
- Virtual joystick on bottom left.
- Pause button on top right.
- Territory percentage at top.
- Match timer.
- Player score.
- AI opponent rankings.
- Mini-map in the upper corner.
- Elimination notifications.
- Clear visual indicators.

9. SKIN SYSTEM
Create a skin collection:
- Classic Square.
- Neon Square.
- Rainbow Square.
- Fire Square.
- Ice Square.
- Galaxy Square.
- Gold Square.
- Shadow Square.

Each skin has a unique appearance.
Allow players to unlock skins using coins.
Include a skin preview and equip button.
Skins are cosmetic and do not change gameplay balance.

10. COIN AND PROGRESSION SYSTEM
- Earn coins after every match.
- Earn additional rewards for winning.
- Reward territory achievements.
- Add player experience points.
- Add player levels.
- Save coins and unlocked skins.
- Include daily login rewards.
- Add achievement missions.

11. PAUSE MENU
Include:
- Resume.
- Restart.
- Settings.
- Main Menu.

12. GAME OVER SCREEN
Display:
- Victory or Defeat.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
